text:
Lena M (partnerships): Kicking off publisher onboarding for the three cloud marketplaces. Goal: get staging manifests, AMI placeholders, and SKU + billing mappings in place this sprint.
Owen R (eng): I'll own AMI build and the Azure listing JSON. For AWS private offers we need a placeholder AMI id to attach; can we use a staging AMI pattern?
Priya T (product): Yes, use STAGE-AMI-XXXX pattern in the CSV and mark state=staging. We'll swap before certification. Also need concise product summaries (<=100 chars) for each plan.
Ethan B (legal): Please include export control classification (ECCN or EAR99). Also brief DPA blurb per SKU. I can paste a template once you share the SKU list.
Nina C (finance): Reminder: marketplace payout reconciliation requires marketplace_sku and internal_revenue_code columns. Add that to the inventory CSV.
publisher-bot: GCP notice: missing billing_contact field in publisher profile. https://cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/publishers
Lena M (partnerships): I'll fill billing_contact this afternoon. Sharing a sample CSV excerpt below for review:
```
sku,display_name,plan_type,price_model,regions,ami_id,state,internal_code,summary
RI-PRIV-VPC,Redwood Private VPC,Subscription,monthly,us-east-1|eu-central-1,STAGE-AMI-0001,staging,INT-PRIV-001,Private deployment with VPC & KMS support
RI-DED-POOL,Redwood Dedicated Pool,Subscription,commit,us-west-2,STAGE-AMI-0002,staging,INT-DED-002,Dedicated GPU pool for inference
RI-HOST-API,Redwood Hosted API,Usage,consumption,global,,pending,INT-HOST-003,Hosted API with streaming & functions
```
Owen R (eng): For the Hosted API plan we won't have an AMI. Mark ami_id empty and set state=pending. Azure manifest requires plan metadata and termsUri. I'll attach a skeleton later.
Priya T (product): I'll prepare the 100-char summaries and 2 price variations (standard + enterprise). Posting drafts by EOD.
Ethan B (legal): Once summaries and AMI placeholders are in, I'll generate the marketplace-friendly legal snippets (data processing + warranties). Watch out for Azure's mandatory terms link.
Nina C (finance): Also flag any entitlements that are non-billable (support-only SKUs) so we exclude them from marketplace billing tables.
Owen R (eng): Sharing quick Azure manifest example I'll use to validate fields:
```
{"offerId":"redwood-private","plans":[{"planId":"private-monthly","sku":"RI-PRIV-VPC","termsUri":"https://redwood.com/terms/marketplace"}]}
```
Lena M (partnerships): Thanks Owen. Action items: (1) Nina & I add billing_contact + internal codes in CSV, (2) Priya drafts summaries + price bands, (3) Owen pushes AMI staging IDs & manifest skeleton, (4) Ethan drafts legal snippets against the SKU list.
publisher-bot: AWS certification window opens in 7 business days for new publisher offers. Ensure test assets are ready.
Priya T (product): Quick Q: Do we want a "trial" plan for Hosted API in marketplace or handle free credits outside of the marketplace?
Nina C (finance): Prefer outside marketplace (free credits tracked in our billing) to avoid marketplace payout complications.
Ethan B (legal): Agreed; marketplace contracts complicate promotional credits.
Lena M (partnerships): OK we'll keep trial outside. I'll schedule a 30-min sync Thursday to review the staging manifests and legal snippets. Ping here if you need edits before then. :calendar:
